faq.q: Is my PDF uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. The file is processed entirely in your browser with a local PDF library, so it never leaves your device and nothing is stored or logged.

faq.q: How do I write the page ranges?
faq.a: Use page numbers and ranges separated by commas, for example 1-3, 5, 8-10. A range ending in a dash, like 7-, runs from that page to the end of the document.

faq.q: What is the difference between the three modes?
faq.a: Extract pages gathers all the pages you list into one new PDF. Split each range creates a separate PDF for every range you list. Split every page makes one PDF per page and ignores the Pages box.

faq.q: Why do I get a ZIP file?
faq.a: When the result is more than one PDF, the files are bundled into a single ZIP so your browser can download everything in one step. A single result downloads directly as a PDF.

faq.q: Can I split a password-protected PDF?
faq.a: Encrypted or password-protected PDFs can't be split directly. Remove the password in your PDF viewer first, then add the file again.
